clues: This city is on the Deccan Plateau in west India. It lies in the same state as the huge city of Mumbai.
Hot days here end in cool nights, thanks to the high land. Then the monsoon rains come in June, and July is the wettest month.
In the 1700s, this city was the seat of the Peshwas. They were the chief men who ran the Maratha realm.
Folks call this place the Oxford of the East. The name fits its famed schools and halls of learning.
The old landmark Shaniwarwada still marks this city. It is one of the famed sights left from its long past.
